articles.summary: Farmers Branch, TX and Livermore, CA – November 12, 2025 – The City of Farmers Branch, Texas and FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM) today announced that FormFactor, a leading global supplier of test and measurement technologies for the semiconductor industry, has begun site work and equipment installation for its new Farmers Branch advanced manufacturing facility.
